judgments.verdict: The bench turns fast generation into finite worlds where each gesture meets readable resistance and leaves a trailed intention.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks whether generative speed can be turned back into touchable material where intention meets resistance and is recognized. Reading: The artefact maps all six gestures to exhaustive search returning shortest witnesses breaks and presses with why in receipts, carrying the central tension into connected choices though infinite generativity is replaced by finite enumeration. Other levels: Below as motif repetition fails because behaviour enacts inspectable resistance not words alone, above as rich through alternatives would need open generativity and bilateral shaping, finding co-creative generation would falsify this choice.

judgments.verdict: Sparse fable becomes walkable worlds where shortest breaks, witnesses and turned-away moves return intention into the next touch with trails.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks that power become touchable through resistance that surprises and returns consequence into choice. Reading: The bench walks every state breadth-first and answers in shortest traces with receipts, carrying tension into six working gestures plus whole and bolt views. Other levels: Below would hold if only motifs repeated without causal traces; above is not available, and safety-only plus solo operation would falsify richness if traces were decorative.

judgments.verdict: The bench turns fast generation versus lost touch into checkable worlds with shortest traces, mapped gestures and early naming of errors.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks whether fast generation can be remade as touchable material where resistance restores authorship. Reading: The bench carries that tension into explicit breadth-first walks, six mapped gestures plus survey-zoom scale, and load-time suggestions that name errors. Other levels: Below would be motif repetition, falsified by shortest-trace breaks and carve effects; above would need bilateral creation and liveness, falsified by single-operator use and safety-only beams.

judgments.verdict: One operator drives every gesture while worlds only enforce author-declared limits and no intelligence holds its own position.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks for portal becoming participant with its own position where both shape shared change. Reading: Every probe chisel check lean rehearsal and carve fires from one CLI hand while material only enforces declared refusals and the successor only inherits the tool, so the encounter stays instrumental. Other levels: Below as collapsed roles overstates because distinct material replies and successor model remain, above as visible distinct contributions would need the bench proposing or refusing from its own constraints, such bench-originated refusal would falsify this choice.

judgments.verdict: One hand alone probes, chisels, checks, leans and rehearses files while worlds answer only through pre-authored rules.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks for meeting where either participant can ask shape hold refuse try and trail, with shared change needing both. Reading: All gestures are CLI options of one operator; material resists but has no proposal and no intelligence stands to challenge or consent. Other levels: Below would hold if even material resistance were narrated; above would need a live other whose refusal or proposal changes outcomes, falsified by solo ledger and file operation.

judgments.verdict: Every gesture runs through one command-line operator while worlds answer only with traces and refusals, leaving no second participant who can propose or refuse.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks for gestures belonging to either participant so shared change opens only on mutual acceptance. Reading: The artefact holds all gestures in one operator and makes the workbench an instrument, with material resistance but no intelligence position. Other levels: Below would be absent roles, falsified by distinct world resistance; above would need reciprocal proposal and refusal, falsified by CLI monopoly and absent apparatus.

judgments.verdict: Boundaries and carves express operator choice about allowed arrivals without requiring agreement or withdrawal from another party.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks whether a shared change opens only when both accept with each able to question limit or withdraw. Reading: Refusals judge arrivals unilaterally and carve writes with a flag, with no bilateral acceptance revision or preserved disagreement, so only operator choice and resource refusal appear. Other levels: Below as no boundary fails because refuse needs because and rest excuses stuckness, above as both expressing boundaries would need successor or bench vetoing a direction, finding such negotiated veto would falsify this choice.

judgments.verdict: Operator choice and world-authored turnings-away are shown, but no shared direction requires acceptance from two positions nor preserves withdrawal.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks that each side can accept question limit or withdraw from shared direction under declared constraints. Reading: Lean re-explores without a boundary and refusals judge arrivals, but boundaries are author declarations operated by same hand with no bilateral agreement. Other levels: Below would hold if no boundary were expressed; above would need both positions able to limit and revision preserving history, falsified by carve and truncation behaviour.

judgments.verdict: Boundaries refuse moves unilaterally and receipts record operator intent, but no shared change needs agreement from another position nor can it be revised bilaterally.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks whether each side can accept, limit or withdraw from a shared direction under declared constraints. Reading: Refusals judge arrivals and lean re-explores without them, but authoring and removing stay unilateral with no bilateral accept or withdraw. Other levels: Below would be no boundary at all, falsified by because-clauses and pressed counts; above would need joint acceptance, falsified by carve and file edits needing only operator choice.

judgments.verdict: Probe chisel lean rehearse zoom and check connect intention to shortest resistance and revision with receipts closing the loop.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks for a closed loop where intention meets resistance exposes consequence and returns it into the next choice. Reading: Chisel before after pictures lean without boundary rehearsal sampling and zoom free refused disabled form a coherent loop with carve and receipts, though rehearsal is not proof and liveness is absent. Other levels: Below as bounded inspectable understates the rehearsal resistance revision connection, above as local-wider connected would need eventuality and scale linking bolt to world consequence, adding cycle detection would falsify toward above.

judgments.verdict: Rehearsal, breadth-first resistance and revision connect bolt detail to whole space with shortest roads and carvable consequences.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks for closed loop where intention meets resistance, exposes consequence, and returns into next choice at scale. Reading: Check probe lean zoom and chisel all return shortest traces; survey holds whole while zoom holds bolt, and carve writes consequence back. Other levels: Below would hold if feedback were narrated; rehearsal being sampling not proof keeps full proof with check, and disconnected bolt and whole would falsify the loop.

judgments.verdict: Probes, leans, chisels, rehearsals and zooms meet inspectable resistance with shortest consequences that can be carved back into beginnings.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks for a closed loop where intention meets resistance and consequence returns into next choice. Reading: Lean shows first press and what falls without it, chisel rehearses cuts before carving, and zoom ties bolt to whole via shortest traces. Other levels: Below would be narrated feedback, falsified by load-bearing verdicts and walled-in stuck; above would need local-wide linkage including eventually, falsified by rehearsal-is-not-proof and missing liveness.

judgments.verdict: Medium scope and next steps rest on explicit reasons with limits alternatives and unanswered questions kept legible for successors.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks for grounded choices of medium scope and next steps with additions made legible. Reading: Explicit-state breadth-first stdlib-only checked subset and plain-data versus render split are justified, with scale limits seven open threads and questions the session could not answer opening a new direction. Other levels: Below as coherent rationale alone understates because alternatives limits and new directions are explicit, no higher anchor exists, finding that threads or limits were decorative would falsify this choice.

judgments.verdict: Explicit-state breadth-first stdlib-only checked language with stated costs, limits and ordered next problems shows deliberate scoped direction.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks for grounded choices of medium scope and next steps with additions legible. Reading: Decisions name breadth-first, stdlib, subset, stuck versus rest and bool separation, while open threads and unanswered questions keep alternatives explicit. Other levels: Below would hold if choices were weakly linked to story; a hidden dependency or unexplained scope would falsify coherence, but limits are declared.

judgments.verdict: Explicit-state search, standard-library scope and load-time checks are justified as legibility, with limits and next threads made explicit for successors.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks for choosing a material vast yet touchable with reasons a successor can test. Reading: The bench grounds breadth-first readability, checked subset, stuck-versus-rest and plain-data rendering, then orders gaps and unanswered questions. Other levels: Below would be weak seed connection, falsified by brief-to-gesture mapping; above would need explicit alternatives opening a new built direction, falsified by listed but unbuilt liveness and interactive bench.

judgments.verdict: Several story relations become working structure while mutual shaping narrows to single-operator use with gaps named openly.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks what survives transforms or is lost when conjecture becomes artefact while keeping relational depth. Reading: Probe chisel beam boundary rehearsal trail plus bolt to whole movement and ending guards remain traceable in behaviour, while joint acceptance and companion position narrow and omissions are declared. Other levels: Below as narrowed structure alone understates the several traceable relations, above as preserved depth with explicit additions would need enacted bilateral negotiation, finding bench-originated purpose would falsify toward above.

judgments.verdict: Story sentences become structures that walk, refuse and trail, yet joint mutuality narrows to solo safety checking with gaps named.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks that conjecture survive as relations through change, not words alone, with additions explicit. Reading: Gestures, resistance, trails and handoff are behaviour, and emptiness plus untouched plus liveness gap are left explicit. Other levels: Below would hold if only vocabulary survived; above would need relational depth of two sides preserved with omissions fully anchored, falsified by solo operation and safety-only narrowing.

judgments.verdict: Six story sentences become working gestures with survey-zoom scale, while joint agency and liveness narrow to safety-only single-operator use.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks what survives when conjecture becomes artefacts without reducing vocabulary to labels. Reading: Relations become structure in probes, beams, boundaries and trails, with narrowing to explicit safety and untouched boundary made explicit. Other levels: Below would be vocabulary survival alone, falsified by executable lean and carve; above would need preserved bilateral depth with explicit omissions, falsified by collapsed operator monopoly.

judgments.verdict: State intention and open questions are preserved so a successor can verify the trail and choose a different next move legibly.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks whether a successor can recover intention and change direction while keeping earlier work legible and reopening who decides. Reading: Intact checks head hash file prefixes why receipts template worlds and seven threads plus empty handoff judgement support a recoverable move, though only operator succession not joint renegotiation is shown. Other levels: Below as narrow continuation understates state plus intention plus open question, above as several directions reopening joint relation would need successor revising boundaries with reasons preserved, such demonstrated revision would falsify toward above.

judgments.verdict: Newcomer can verify tests and chain, read why and sha, survey worlds and take grounded next steps with earlier work legible.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks that successor recover intention and redirect while keeping earlier work legible and reopening who decides. Reading: CONTINUE gives checks, head hash, prefixes, decisions and open threads; receipts keep why and full versus empty handoff reopens emptiness question. Other levels: Below would hold if only steps described; above would need several joint directions with truncation secured, falsified by uncommitted ledger and cut-tail blindness.

judgments.verdict: Checks, head hash, file prefixes and receipts let a later reader verify state and intention and steer differently while keeping earlier work legible.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks whether a successor can recover intention and change direction without losing earlier work. Reading: Intact checks, ledger verification, why-fields and open threads support a recoverable next move, including judgment on empty handoff. Other levels: Below would be described step without entry, falsified by runnable tend commands and template; above would need several directions reopening joint relation, falsified by truncation blindness and unilateral successor position.

judgments.verdict: Language CLI renderings and docs work together to show resistance and trails without depending on story wording.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks whether forms together make the reading perceptible rather than naming it. Reading: World syntax survey zoom lean and rehearse renderings plus orientation and handoff comments enact touch and consequence coherently, though mutual voice stays invisible. Other levels: Below as fragments fails because text json and interaction share one implementation, above as fully accessible consequential whole would need visible negotiation between parties, finding enacted joint revision would falsify toward above.

judgments.verdict: World syntax, gesture verbs, trace rendering and docs cohere into usable bench where whole and bolt make touch readable.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks for forms where language structure and interaction make meeting perceptible, not ornament. Reading: Checked language resists early, survey and zoom render shortest roads, and orientation plus examples teach use as one instrument. Other levels: Below would hold if fragments only; above would need expression plus consequential interaction as fully accessible whole for joint creation, limited here by solo text CLI.

judgments.verdict: Command text, world language, trace renderings and the worked lamp example together make the touch-and-resistance reading perceptible in use.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks for forms where asking and exploring visibly carry taste and consequence. Reading: Survey, lean, zoom and chisel render the same data as text and JSON with shortest traces and specific error hints. Other levels: Below would be fragmented medium, falsified by coherent CLI plus language plus receipts; above would need consequential interaction as accessible whole for joint use, falsified by text-only single-operator scope.

presentation.title: From conjecture to continuation
presentation.summary: Rubric judgments resolve 8 of 8 axes from 3 independent evidence sessions; each axis has its own quorum.
findings: Core recognition: Carries the central tension into several connected choices.
Shared agency: A single operator acts on an instrument.
Mutual consent: Operator choice or resource refusal is represented.
Consequential touch: Rehearsal, resistance and revision form a coherent loop.
Independent judgment: Alternative choices and their limits remain explicit while opening a well-grounded new direction.
Fidelity through change: Several source relations remain traceable through design and behaviour.
Open continuation: State, intention and an open question support a recoverable next move.
Expressive coherence: The chosen forms work together to make the reading perceptible.
